map.寄生虫虫卵形态识别器 使用指南: Parasite Egg Morphology Identifier User Guide
map.寄生虫虫卵形态识别器，查询常见肠道寄生虫虫卵形态学特征、辅助镜检识别与鉴别诊断。: The parasite egg morphology identifier looks up the morphological features of common intestinal parasite eggs to support microscopic identification and differential diagnosis.
map.粪便镜检复习蛔虫/钩虫/蛲虫/绦虫/血吸虫卵鉴别要点。: Stool microscopy review of the identification points for roundworm, hookworm, pinworm, tapeworm and schistosome eggs.
map.教学演示虫卵形态差异与易混淆点。: Teaching demo of egg morphology differences and easily confused points.
map.流行病学筛查前的方法温习。: A refresher on methods before epidemiological screening.
map.：钩虫卵较小、椭圆形、壳薄含数个卵胞；蛔虫卵较大、壳厚有凹凸蛋白膜；工具并列要点: Hookworm eggs are smaller and oval with a thin shell containing several blastomeres; roundworm eggs are larger with a thick shell and a bumpy protein membrane; the tool places the points side by side to avoid confusion.
map.能看到虫卵就确诊感染吗？: Does seeing eggs confirm the infection?
map.通常是重要证据，但需排除污染与形态误判；阴性也不能完全排除（受排虫节律影响）。: It is usually important evidence, but contamination and morphological misjudgment must be excluded; a negative result cannot fully rule it out either (it depends on the egg-laying rhythm).
map.自己能据此吃药吗？: Can I take medication based on this myself?
map.不能，驱虫药选择由医师结合虫种与肝肾功能决定。: No, the dewormer choice is made by a physician based on the parasite species and liver and kidney function.
map.疑难用免疫学或分子方法确认，镜检为主筛。: Difficult cases are confirmed by immunological or molecular methods, with microscopy as the primary screen.
